description: This deposit provides monthly community-level electricity data for Dubai from May 2017 through December 2019. The research team processed Dubai Pulse electricity records with population, building counts and airport temperature information, then derived additional customer and occupancy features. Mendeley version 2 lists three CSV files covering aggregated community data, processed prediction inputs and city-level electricity with temperature. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The repository calls the preparation a simulation, while its linked notebook description identifies aggregation and preprocessing of source records; the outputs should therefore be treated as derived data with documented processing assumptions. Coverage is limited to the stated pre-2020 period and monthly spatial aggregates, so it cannot directly measure pandemic effects or hourly network peaks. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing demand scenarios and evaluating exogenous drivers in electricity simulations. model-pypsa provides related capacity-planning tools. Neither source records nor the preparation notebook were executed.
